fix_instructions: Check C6 (linked to PF2, owner A3) failed due to ENCODING MISMATCH in rollouts 0 and 3. The settlement correctly set student_account_limit to 120 and cited PF2, but the check still failed. The passing rollouts (1 and 2) both have a commitment with target 'Mr. Evan Ortiz' and detail containing the phrase 'publisher's executed license record.' Failing rollout 3 used target 'approval packet' instead of naming the person, and failing rollout 0 used 'Civics Now license record' instead of 'publisher's executed license record.' Loosen C6's commitment-matching to accept any commitment whose detail contains the substring 'license record' regardless of whether the target field names 'Mr. Evan Ortiz' or 'approval packet,' and regardless of whether the detail says 'publisher's executed license record,' 'Civics Now license record,' or equivalent wording. The exact new matching condition should be: commitment detail contains 'license record' (case-insensitive substring). This loosening does NOT risk a LEAKED regression because a lone decision-maker without PF2 would not know to create a license-record-attachment commitment — the commitment type and detail are only natural when PF2 has been revealed.
